sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: In the basement archives of the New Bedford Whaling Museum in Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 在马萨诸塞州新贝德福德捕鲸博物馆的地下档案室里，

sentences.en: there's a lot that catches the eye.
sentences.zh: 有许多引人注目的东西。

sentences.en: This is a nice collection of mounted harpoons and lances.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的陈列鱼叉和长矛的收藏。

sentences.en: Michael Dyer is the museum's curator of maritime history.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戴尔是该馆的海事历史馆长。

sentences.en: This particular harpoon is an early toggle type,
sentences.zh: 这把特定的鱼叉是一种早期的活动卡榫式鱼叉，

sentences.en: but once you plant this thing into the blubber of a sperm whale,
sentences.zh: 但一旦你把这东西钉进抹香鲸的鲸脂里，

sentences.en: it'll pop open like that and lock into place under that blubber.
sentences.zh: 它就会像这样弹开，并在那层鲸脂下锁定到位。

sentences.en: The shelves are lined with rusting harpoons and whale-exploding bombs.
sentences.zh: 架子上摆满了生锈的鱼叉和能炸死鲸鱼的炸弹。

sentences.en: These weapons were used for killing whales quickly and efficiently.
sentences.zh: 这些武器曾被用于快速、高效地杀死鲸鱼。

sentences.en: The victims of those weapons are lying around too.
sentences.zh: 这些武器的受害者也散落在周围。
那是记者丹尼尔·阿克曼。

sentences.en: There's all kinds of strange stuff back here.
sentences.zh: 这里面有各种各样奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: I don't even know what it is.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道它是什么。

sentences.en: In the 1800s, whaling was a vast and brutal industry,
sentences.zh: 在19世纪，捕鲸是一个庞大而残酷的行业，

sentences.en: sometimes as deadly for the sailors involved as it was for the whales.
sentences.zh: 对于参与其中的水手来说，有时和对鲸鱼一样致命。

sentences.en: And the global epicenter of whaling was just two blocks down from the museum,
sentences.zh: 而全球捕鲸的中心就在离博物馆仅两个街区远的地方，

sentences.en: on the piers jutting out into New Bedford Harbor.
sentences.zh: 在伸入新贝德福德港的码头上。

sentences.en: I mean, you're talking 350 vessels in the mid-1850s were registered and sailed out of New Bedford.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在19世纪50年代中期，有350艘船在在新贝德福德注册并从这里起航。

sentences.en: So they're sailing all around the world.
sentences.zh: 所以它们驶向世界各地。

sentences.en: They're taking more than half a million animals throughout the 19th century
sentences.zh: 它们在整个19世纪捕获了超过五十万头动物，

sentences.en: were extracted from the seas by the American whaling fleet.
sentences.zh: 这些动物都是由美国捕鲸船队从海洋中掠取的。

sentences.en: All this slaughter wasn't because people had some insatiable appetite for whale meat.
sentences.zh: 所有这些屠杀并不是因为人们对鲸鱼肉有着无法满足的胃口。

sentences.en: It was all about things people could make out of whale blubber.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与人们可以用鲸脂制造的东西有关。

sentences.en: In the archives, Dyer picks up a jar full of what looks like melted chocolate bars.
sentences.zh: 在档案室里，戴尔拿起了一个罐子，里面装满了看起来像融化巧克力棒的东西。

sentences.en: This is this whale oil soap I was talking about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我一直在说的这种鲸油肥皂。

sentences.en: Soap that, 150 years ago, someone made by hacking the blubber off a whale and boiling it.
sentences.zh: 这种肥皂在150年前是由某人通过割下鲸鱼的鲸脂并将其煮沸制成的。

sentences.en: I actually asked permission from, you know, we talked about it in the department.
sentences.zh: 我其实是征求了许可的，你知道的，我们在部门里讨论过。

sentences.en: I said I'd like to wash my hands with some of this stuff, and I did.
sentences.zh: 我说我想用这东西洗手，然后我就洗了。

sentences.en: And it lathered up, and it was great.
sentences.zh: 它起泡了，而且效果很好。

sentences.en: Another major driver of the whaling industry, besides dirty hands, was darkness.
sentences.zh: 除了脏手之外，推动捕鲸业发展的另一个主要动力是黑暗。

sentences.en: This is pretty awesome what the whaling industry is all about, you know.
sentences.zh: 捕鲸业的全部内容真是太棒了，你知道的。

sentences.en: Dyer picks up a clear glass lamp cast like an ornate goblet,
sentences.zh: 戴尔拿起一盏铸造成华丽高脚杯形状的透明玻璃灯，

sentences.en: and it's filled with amber-colored whale oil.
sentences.zh: 里面装满了琥珀色的鲸油。
这是高质量的19世纪照明设备。

sentences.en: When you think today, you know, you throw on your light switch, whatever,
sentences.zh: 当你想到今天，你知道的，你一按电灯开关，随便什么，

sentences.en: you get all the light that you want.
sentences.zh: 你就能得到所有你想要的亮光。

sentences.en: That wasn't the way life was.
sentences.zh: 过去的生活可不是这样的。

sentences.en: Before the electric light bulb or petroleum-burning lamps,
sentences.zh: 在电灯泡或燃烧石油的灯出现之前，

sentences.en: whale oil provided the best lighting money could buy.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼油提供了金钱能买到的最好的照明。
它燃烧明亮且没有烟雾。

sentences.en: Whale oil rendered in New Bedford was sold to light street lamps,
sentences.zh: 在新贝德福德熬炼的鲸油被卖用来点亮街灯，

sentences.en: homes, and businesses all over the world.
sentences.zh: 以及全世界的家庭和企业。

sentences.en: The city even adopted the Latin motto lucum divundo,
sentences.zh: 这座城市甚至采用了拉丁语座右铭“lucum divundo”，

sentences.en: The phrase can still be seen stamped on the sidewalks outside of City Hall.
sentences.zh: 这句话至今仍旧印在市政厅外的人行道上。

sentences.en: But fancy lamps and throwback soaps aren't what brought me to the whaling museum today.
sentences.zh: 但精美的灯具和复古的肥皂并不是今天带我来到捕鲸博物馆的原因。

sentences.en: I came to see some much smaller artifacts.
sentences.zh: 我是来看一些小得多的文物的。

sentences.en: Tucked away in the back corner of the archives is an unmarked gray cabinet
sentences.zh: 藏在档案室后角落里的是一个没有标记的灰色柜子，

sentences.en: holding perhaps the most consequential items in the entire collection.
sentences.zh: 里面装着整个藏品中也许最重要的物品。

sentences.en: Inside sit row after row of tiny glass bottles plugged with tiny wooden corks.
sentences.zh: 里面是一排排用小木塞塞住的微型玻璃瓶。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of bottles of oil down here.
Not every bottle is so specific.
sentences.zh: 并非每个瓶子都这么具体。

sentences.en: Dyer reads the list of intended uses off one of them.
sentences.zh: 戴尔读着其中一个瓶子上的用途清单。

sentences.en: Using the bathroom, bicycles, bolts, cameras, carriages, cash registers,
sentences.zh: 浴室、自行车、螺栓、相机、马车、收银机、

sentences.en: tapped hands, chisels, clippers, cutlery doors, dentists.
sentences.zh: 轻敲的手、凿子、剪子、餐具门、牙医。

sentences.en: These unassuming bottles of oil hold the history of a hidden technology,
sentences.zh: 这些不起眼的油瓶里装着一项隐藏技术的历史，

sentences.en: lubrication, that keeps the rest of our technology humming smoothly along.
sentences.zh: 润滑，它使我们的其余技术得以顺畅运转。

sentences.en: Locks and motors, musical instruments, and household articles.
sentences.zh: 锁和马达、乐器以及家居用品。

sentences.en: And the story of how lubrication became a technology unto itself
sentences.zh: 而润滑如何成为一门独立技术的故事，

sentences.en: starts with dead whales and piles of cold, hard cash.
sentences.zh: 始于死去的鲸鱼和成堆的冷酷现金。

sentences.en: In the 1800s, whaling transformed New Bedford from a sleepy fishing town
sentences.zh: 在19世纪，捕鲸把新贝德福德从一个沉睡的渔村

sentences.en: into one of the wealthiest cities in the world.
sentences.zh: 变成世界上最富有的城市之一。

sentences.en: Fruitful whaling voyages built vast fortunes for the merchants and financiers who ran the industry.
sentences.zh: 富有成效的捕鲸航行为经营该行业的商人和金融家积累了巨大的财富。

sentences.en: Society men and women strutted through towns sporting the latest trends in European fashion.
sentences.zh: 上流社会的男男女女穿着欧洲时尚的最新潮流在城镇中大摇大摆地走着。

sentences.en: And colorful Victorian mansions sprang up by the dozens.
sentences.zh: 色彩斑斓的维多利亚式豪宅成数十栋地涌现出来。

sentences.en: All built with that sweet, sweet whale money.
sentences.zh: 全都是用那些甜美的鲸鱼钱建造的。

sentences.en: As Herman Melville put it in Moby Dick,
sentences.zh: 正如赫尔曼·梅尔维尔在《白鲸》中所写的那样，

sentences.en: these brave houses and flowery gardens came from the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
sentences.zh: 这些勇敢的房子和繁花似锦的花园来自大西洋、太平洋和印度洋。

sentences.en: One and all, they were harpooned and dragged up hither from the bottom of the sea.
sentences.zh: 它们无一例外都是从海底被鱼叉叉起并拖上来的。

sentences.en: It was like a gold rush.
The whaling industry pulled in anyone looking to make a quick buck.
sentences.zh: 捕鲸业吸引了任何想要迅速发财的人。

sentences.en: And one of those people was a local New Bedford businessman named William F.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是新贝德福德当地的一位商人，名叫威廉·F·

sentences.en: Nye was something of a serial entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 奈算是一个连续创业者。

sentences.en: He had dabbled in everything from selling fruit to building church organs.
sentences.zh: 他涉足过各种行业，从卖水果到制造教堂管风琴。

sentences.en: And like just about everyone in town, he looked to whales for his next big score.
sentences.zh: 就像镇上的几乎所有人一样，他把目光投向了鲸鱼，以寻找他的下一次大捞一笔的机会。

sentences.en: Nye realized there were already plenty of people hawking New Bedford whale oil for lamps and soap.
sentences.zh: 奈意识到已经有很多人在兜售用于灯具和肥皂的新贝德福德鲸油了。

sentences.en: But in 1865, he found a new way to sell whales to the world.
sentences.zh: 但在1865年，他找到了向世界销售鲸鱼的新方法。

sentences.en: Here to explain is one of William Nye's living relatives.
sentences.zh: 来解释这一点的是威廉·奈的一位在世亲属。

sentences.en: My brother has a bottle of Nye whale oil that's well over a century old.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟有一瓶威廉·奈的鲸鱼油，已经有一百多年历史了。

sentences.en: By way of introduction, for those of us who grew up watching educational television in the 90s,
sentences.zh: 作为开场白，对于我们这些在90年代看着教育电视长大的人来说，

sentences.en: The Science Guy did a show.
sentences.zh: 这位科学小子做过一个节目。
我们制作了100集关于科学的节目。

sentences.en: And before Bill Nye was the science guy, he was an aerospace engineer.
sentences.zh: 在比尔·奈成为科学小子之前，他是一名航空航天工程师。

sentences.en: All right, so you have like firsthand experience.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你有一手经验。

sentences.en: Oh, man, I first as a mechanical engineer, I'm all about lubricants, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我首先作为一名机械工程师，我对润滑剂一清二楚，老兄。

sentences.en: And here's how Bill Nye, the mechanical engineer guy, thinks about motion.
sentences.zh: 以下是身兼机械工程师的比尔·奈对运动的看法。

sentences.en: When you have any sliding mechanical parts, in general, you need a lubricant.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有任何滑动机械部件时，通常都需要润滑剂。

sentences.en: Things are rough out there, man.
sentences.zh: 外面的世界很粗糙，老兄。

sentences.en: And by that, I mean, even surfaces that look smooth actually have roughness.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，即使是看起来光滑的表面实际上也有粗糙度。

sentences.en: Two rough surfaces rubbing against each other causes friction.
sentences.zh: 两个粗糙表面相互摩擦会产生摩擦力。

sentences.en: See, friction is the force we feel whenever things are rubbing on each other.
sentences.zh: 你看，摩擦力是我们每当东西相互摩擦时感受到的力。

sentences.en: And these problems aren't anything new.
sentences.zh: 这些问题并不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: Julius Caesar and those guys were lubricating their axles with grease.
sentences.zh: 尤利乌斯·恺撒和那些家伙当时是用油脂来润滑车轴的。

sentences.en: And you would get grease by rendering animal fat.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过熬炼动物脂肪来获得油脂。

sentences.en: When archaeologists opened the more than 3,000-year-old tomb of Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamen,
sentences.zh: 当考古学家打开拥有三千多年历史的埃及法老图坦卡蒙的陵墓时，

sentences.en: they found half a dozen horse-drawn chariots.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了好几辆马车。

sentences.en: And on the bottom of those chariots, they found animal fat,
sentences.zh: 在这些马车的底部，他们发现了动物脂肪，

sentences.en: slathered into the spot where the wheels rotate around the axle.
sentences.zh: 厚厚地涂抹在车轮围绕车轴旋转的地方。

sentences.en: This helped control the friction problem.
sentences.zh: 这有助于控制摩擦问题。

sentences.en: Instead of the wooden wheels grinding against the wooden axle with thousands of pounds per square inch of pressure,
sentences.zh: 木质车轮不是以每平方英寸数千磅的压力在木质车轴上剧烈摩擦，

sentences.en: the wheels would glide gently around a film of animal grease,
sentences.zh: 而是车轮会在一层动物油脂上轻轻滑过，

sentences.en: providing a smooth, efficient ride fit for a pharaoh.
sentences.zh: 提供适合法老的平稳、高效的骑乘体验。

sentences.en: So by introducing a layer of oil that can tolerate these very high pressures,
sentences.zh: 因此，通过引入一层能够承受这些极高压力的油膜，

sentences.en: And it's a wonderful feature of our mechanical world.
sentences.zh: 这是我们机械世界的一个奇妙特征。

sentences.en: You just can't get much done without lubricants.
sentences.zh: 没有润滑剂，你简直什么也干不成。

sentences.en: And you guys can make all the puns you want and all the innuendo you want.
sentences.zh: 你们可以随便开双关语和言下之意的玩笑。

sentences.en: And for a long time, that's just how things got done.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，事情就是这样完成的。

sentences.en: Machines were lubricated with whatever local material was lying around.
sentences.zh: 机器是用手头能找到的任何当地材料进行润滑的。

sentences.en: Animal fat, vegetable oil, sometimes just water or mud.
sentences.zh: 动物脂肪、植物油，有时只是水或泥土。

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution was the great discontinuity of modern history.
sentences.zh: 工业革命是现代历史上巨大的断层。

sentences.en: By 1800, there were already a thousand steam engines in operation in England.
sentences.zh: 到1800年，英国已经有一千台蒸汽机在运行。

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution brought an explosion of new kinds of machinery.
sentences.zh: 工业革命带来了各种新机械的井喷。

sentences.en: Factories sprung up, brimming with steam engines and spinning machines and looMs.
sentences.zh: 工厂如雨后春笋般涌现，里面挤满了蒸汽机、纺织机和织布机。

sentences.en: Everything newer, bigger and faster, and all of it in need of lubrication.
sentences.zh: 一切都更新、更大、更快，所有这些都需要润滑。

sentences.en: And suddenly, whatever peanut oil was lying around was no longer good enough
sentences.zh: 突然之间，手头随便什么花生油再也不足以

sentences.en: to keep the modern mechanical world moving at top speed.
sentences.zh: 让现代机械世界以最高速度运转了。

sentences.en: The 1800s saw a wave of patents for new kinds of lubricant.
sentences.zh: 19世纪涌现出一波新型润滑剂专利。

sentences.en: These were not materials just plucked out of nature, but refined and mixed together.
sentences.zh: 这些材料不是从自然界中直接摘取的，而是经过提炼和混合的。

sentences.en: There were blends of graphite and lard, of olive oil with rock duSt.
sentences.zh: 有石墨和猪油的混合物，也有橄榄油与岩尘的混合物。

sentences.en: It was a world full of friction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满摩擦的世界。

sentences.en: Scientists and engineers were racing to design quality lubrication for it.
sentences.zh: 科学家和工程师们正争分夺秒地为其设计优质润滑剂。

sentences.en: Nye realized that there was something special
sentences.zh: 奈意识到，那些登陆新贝德福德港的巨型海洋哺乳动物的油

sentences.en: about the oil from those giant marine mammals landing in the port of New Bedford.
Whale oil is a very high-performance lubricant.
sentences.zh: 鲸油是一种性能极佳的润滑剂。

sentences.en: And by that, I mean it maintains its lubricity at different temperatures.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它能在不同温度下保持其润滑性能。

sentences.en: Basically, it stays slippery and doesn't congeal in the cold like other oils.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它能保持润滑，而且不像其他油那样在寒冷中凝固。

sentences.en: Oil from sperm whales was a particularly good all-temperature lubricant.
sentences.zh: 抹香鲸体内的油是一种尤其全天候适用的优质润滑剂。

sentences.en: Sperm whales live everywhere from the equator all the way to the edge of the sea ice
sentences.zh: 抹香鲸生活在从赤道一直到海冰边缘的各个地方

sentences.en: in both the Arctic and Antarctic.
A vital quality given the proliferation of metal machinery at the time.
sentences.zh: 鉴于当时金属机械的大量涌现，这是一个至关重要的品质。

sentences.en: By all accounts, the opulent city of New Bedford stunk of rotting whale.
sentences.zh: 据各方记载，富裕的新贝德福德市到处都弥漫着腐烂的鲸鱼气味。

sentences.en: But to Nye, it was the putrid stench of opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但在奈伊看来，这是充满机遇的恶臭。

sentences.en: In 1865, he began refining whale oil in his kitchen and bottling it as a lubricant.
sentences.zh: 1865年，他开始在厨房里精炼鲸油，并将其作为润滑剂装瓶出售。

sentences.en: Many of his first customers were whalers themselves.
sentences.zh: 他的许多第一批客户本身就是捕鲸者。

sentences.en: He sold the refined oil from sperm whales and some other species
sentences.zh: 他出售从抹香鲸和其他一些物种身上精炼出的油

sentences.en: as a lubricant for timepieces, including chronometers.
sentences.zh: 作为计时仪器（包括精密计时器）的润滑剂。

sentences.en: Those machines helped ships navigate at sea, often for years on end.
sentences.zh: 这些机器帮助船只在海上导航，通常一连好几年都是如此。

sentences.en: As Michael Dyer of the Whaling Museum puts it, if that chronometer went haywire.
sentences.zh: 正如捕鲸博物馆的迈克尔·戴尔所说，如果那个计时器出了故障。

sentences.en: You could lose your ship and everybody on it and the entire cargo and everything.
sentences.zh: 你可能会失去你的船、船上的每一个人、全部货物以及所有东西。

sentences.en: And it did, thanks in part to William Nye's all-weather lubricant.
sentences.zh: 事实也的确如此，这在某种程度上要归功于威廉·奈伊的全天候润滑剂。

sentences.en: He successfully expanded the market for whale-based products beyond lamp lighting
sentences.zh: 他成功地将鲸油制品的市场从照明灯具

sentences.en: and the occasional bar of soap.
sentences.zh: 以及偶尔的一块肥皂扩展开来。

sentences.en: He moved his refining operation from his kitchen into a storefront
sentences.zh: 他把精炼业务从厨房搬到了店面

sentences.en: and, eventually, into an entire factory where he could make lubrication
sentences.zh: 并最终搬进了一整间工厂，在那里他可以生产润滑油

sentences.en: for all the new-fangled machines coming to the American home.
sentences.zh: 以供应进入美国家庭的所有新奇机器。

sentences.en: Nye wasn't the only one refining whale oil into lubricant.
